chunks: “If you bury something in the ground, then have witnesses over it, for it will not return anything to you.”

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground or earth in which something is buried
key_terms.دَفَنْتَ: you buried or concealed something underground
key_terms.فَأَشْهِدْ: bring witnesses or make others testify to it

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say to have witnesses when burying something in the ground?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that when a person buries property in the earth, he should establish witnesses for it. The hadith emphasizes practical caution in safeguarding wealth and avoiding later disputes or loss.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3364 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you bury something in the ground, have witnesses for it, for the earth will not return anything to you."
